property_summary: For any admissible input that does not revert, `transfer` must return true; the mutant returns false on non-reverting successful executions, violating this invariant.
For any non-reverting call to transfer, the return value must be true; the buggy version returns false, violating this invariant.
After a non-reverting call to transfer, the returned boolean must be true; the buggy version omits the return statement and thus returns false for any input that does not revert.
When a call to transfer succeeds (does not revert), the function must return the boolean true; the bug omits the return statement and returns false for any non-reverting input.
For any input where transfer does not revert, the function must return true; the bug removes the return statement so it returns false.
